segments.title: A book nobody can read
segments.say: There's a book nobody on Earth can read. It's called the Voynich manuscript.

segments.title: 240 pages. Unknown script.
bullets: A language no one can identify
segments.say: It has two hundred and forty pages. It's written in a script found nowhere else. And no one knows the language.

segments.title: Plants nobody can name
segments.sub: Drawings of **plants no one can identify**
segments.say: It's full of drawings, like plants that no one can identify.

segments.title: 1400s or 1500s
segments.sub: Many have tried. **No one has decoded it.**
segments.say: It's thought to date to the fourteen hundreds or fifteen hundreds. Many have tried to decode it. No one has.

segments.sub: Code, made-up language, or hoax? Comment below
segments.say: So what is it? A secret code, a lost language, or a hoax? Tell me in the comments.
